members.source_document: CIS Controls v8
members.description: Establish and maintain a data recovery process. In the process, address the scope of data recovery activities, recovery prioritization, and the security of backup data.

members.source_document: CIS Controls v8
members.description: Perform automated backups of in-scope enterprise assets. Data backups must be run weekly, or more frequently, based on the sensitivity of the data.

members.source_document: CIS Controls v8
members.description: Designate one key person, and at least one backup, who will manage the enterprise's incident handling process.

members.source_document: Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC 2-2024)
members.description: Cybersecurity requirements for protection of the email serviceofthe entity shall include the following as a minimum: 2.4.3.1 Analyzing and filtering email messages (specifically phishing emails and spam emails) using modern and advanced email protection techniques and mechanisms.

members.source_document: Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC 2-2024)
members.description: Cybersecurity requirements for backup and recovery management within the entity shall be identified, documented, and approved.

members.source_document: Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC 2-2024)
members.description: Cybersecurity requirements for backup and recovery management within the entity shall be implemented.

members.source_document: Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC 2-2024)
members.description: Cybersecurity requirements for backup and recovery management shall include the following as a minimum: 2.9.3.1 Scope of backups to cover critical technology and information assets.

members.source_document: Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC 2-2024)
members.description: The implementation of cybersecurity requirements for backup and recovery management within the entity shall be periodically reviewed.

members.source_document: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise
members.description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of backup software or configurations that are installed on a system.

members.source_document: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise
members.description: Adversaries may install code on externally facing portals, such as a VPN login page, to capture and transmit credentials of users who attempt to log into the service.

members.source_document: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise
members.description: Adversaries may create multiple stages for command and control that are employed under different conditions or for certain functions.

members.source_document: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise
members.description: Adversaries may gather credential material by invoking or forcing a user to automatically provide authentication information through a mechanism in which they can intercept.

members.source_document: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise
members.description: An adversary may create a snapshot or data backup within a cloud account to evade defenses.

members.source_document: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise
members.description: Adversaries may delete or remove built-in data and turn off services designed to aid in the recovery of a corrupted system to prevent recovery.(Citation: Talos Olympic Destroyer 2018)(Citation: FireEye WannaCry 2017) This may deny access to available backups and recovery options.

members.source_document: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise
members.description: Adversaries may abuse mmc.exe to proxy execution of malicious .msc files.

members.description: Implementing a secure backup solution with periodic testing of data restoration capabilities.
